About me

Looking for practical AI solutions to improve your social media & marketing? I help brands grow with content made with AI, automation, and social media systems designed to save time and bring real results.

My specialty is growth led by the community. I help Web3 and crypto businesses grow on Reddit and Instagram with real community engagement. I research the right subreddits and audiences first, then create content that belongs there and start conversations that turn readers into members.

Alongside community work, I build the systems that keep your marketing running while you focus on your product: AI chatbots that answer customers, automated workflows that remove repetitive tasks, and content pipelines that plan, create and publish consistently across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, X and TikTok.

Whether you need one channel managed properly or a complete content system built with AI, you get the same thing from me: clear communication, consistent delivery, and work adapted to your project's requirements and your working hours.
